independentNativeAutoplayAudit.method: Fresh standalone Chrome with document-user-activation-required; CDP observes without userGesture until loader is gone, activation=false, intro paused/unmuted/volume=.25 and visible recovery entry. A real Playwright click then starts native playback with activation=true at volume=.25. No product or protected audio test changes.

limitations: The inherited video-audio.spec.js native-policy case timed out returning false in both test-runner invocations. Its harness-specific reason is not established; these runs are recorded as failures, not 12/12. The same complete native rejection and real-click recovery criteria passed in an independent fresh Chrome audit.
